title: The Art & Hustle of Philly Street Photography.

people.name: Sam (Sammy) Rivera
people.asStated: "I am a Philadelphia street photographer" (0:29); from New Jersey, came to Philly for school, 8 years in Philly / 6 as resident (25:07); member of the Public Ledger collective

people.name: Jay Espinal
people.asStated: Host of Creative Talks; only asks questions and tags along, never says he shoots anywhere

mentions.speaker: Sam Rivera (guest)
mentions.quote: We are here in Writtenhouse to uh start our day
mentions.locationEvidence: "Writtenhouse" = Rittenhouse; at 1:37 he spots a man and moves in close ("I want to try to get in close"); at 36:05 he confirms it was a frame made in the park: "at the very start of when we started filming the guy in the park with the newspaper and stuff ... after I shoot it, I got to keep moving". The route then heads east from here, consistent with Rittenhouse Square.
mentions.notes: The start-point alone would not count, but the 36:05 callback confirms a photo was made in the park at the start. Exact spot in the square not stated.

mentions.speaker: Sam Rivera (guest)
mentions.quote: 15th and Chestnut is like the uh, is like the meeting spot cuz that's where we just coincidentally it's a great intersection with great light in the afternoon.
mentions.locationEvidence: Cross streets said outright: 15th and Chestnut. Continues: "you just show up there and there's going to be another street photographer there."
mentions.notes: Stated as a shared habit of Sam and the Public Ledger collective photographers; best afternoon light. Strongest pin in the video.

mentions.place: Walnut St / Chestnut St, Rittenhouse Square east to Broad St
mentions.speaker: Sam Rivera (guest)
mentions.quote: take Walnut, Chestnut, make our way down to Broad Street, City Hall.
mentions.locationEvidence: Introduced at 1:11 as "typical route for me"; "make our way east from here" (from Rittenhouse) along Walnut and Chestnut to Broad St. Roughly 18th St to Broad St.
mentions.notes: Part of one stated typical route (Rittenhouse -> Walnut/Chestnut -> Broad/City Hall -> Market St east). Which of the two streets and which blocks are not specified. Unlocated frames made mid-walk (dog portrait 12:00, portrait 22:47) probably fall on this stretch but are never placed.

mentions.speaker: Sam Rivera (guest)
mentions.quote: take Walnut, Chestnut, make our way down to Broad Street, City Hall.
mentions.locationEvidence: Named waypoint of his "typical route"; repeated mid-walk at 17:13: "Circle back this way. Head to city hall and then head down market."
mentions.notes: Waypoint on the habitual route; no frame explicitly tied to City Hall in the transcript.

mentions.place: Market St, east of City Hall
mentions.speaker: Sam Rivera (guest)
mentions.quote: we're going to keep heading east, head down Market Street.
mentions.locationEvidence: Part of the "typical route for me"; east from City Hall down Market St. Repeated at 17:13 "head down market".
mentions.notes: How far east is not stated ("see where we end up from there"). No frame explicitly tied to Market St.

mentions.place: Fountain where kids were playing (unnamed; possibly Dilworth Park at City Hall, or the Rittenhouse Square fountain)
mentions.speaker: Sam Rivera (guest)
mentions.quote: Like the kids that were just playing in the fountain.
mentions.locationEvidence: None stated. Said about 3.5 minutes after "Head to city hall and then head down market" (17:13), so Dilworth Park's fountain is a plausible guess; the walk also began at Rittenhouse Square, which has a fountain.
mentions.notes: Doubly uncertain: he refers to kids they just saw as great subject matter but never says he made a frame, and the fountain is not named. Needs the footage to confirm both.

mentions.speaker: Sam Rivera (guest)
mentions.quote: I take a lot of photos on the L cuz that's just such an integral part of my life.
mentions.locationEvidence: "the L" = the El, Philadelphia's Market-Frankford elevated/subway line. No station or stretch named.
mentions.notes: Clear habit, but a whole transit line, not a pinnable place; low confidence is about location, not about the habit. "Like I said" refers to an earlier remark not in the edit.

excluded.why: "Might take a lap around Chinatown" - tentative plan, never shown or mentioned as carried out.

"I got a job at Sweet Green downtown ... before and after work. I would just, you know, do my rounds" and 34:18 "force myself to go out downtown" - genuine habit but region-level; the specific places are covered by the route and 15th & Chestnut.

excluded.what: Corner by a church where he photographed a family waiting for a bus last year
excluded.why: Single past photo ("I took last year actually at that corner uh, of the church"), not shot in this video and not stated as a haunt; place unnamed. Listed under unresolved.
Biography: school trip to see a Dave Heath exhibition; no shooting.
Venue of the Public Ledger group show; not a shooting location.
"this is a gallery right here ... I had some work in here for an exhibition" - exhibition venue, relationship not shooting; unnamed.

excluded.what: Bar hosting his First Friday show

unresolved.what: Dog portrait ("can I take a picture of your dog?") - frame clearly made, location never said; on the walk east from Rittenhouse, likely Walnut or Chestnut St
Freestyle rapper/street performer Sam says he sees "out here every once in a while" - a regular performer spot a local could place; no frame confirmed
"that corner ... of the church" with scaffolding and a bus stop, pointed at on camera shortly after "Head to city hall" - church not named (a local could identify from footage)
Fountain with kids playing, referred to as just seen - Dilworth Park vs Rittenhouse Square fountain vs other

Asked-for portrait ("Yo, feel free to say no. Can I take a picture?" ... "That's sick") - frame made, location unnamed; right beside the unnamed gallery where Sam exhibited last winter, which would pin it
"There's a guy on top of a truck over there" - Sam goes to look, probably shoots; location unnamed, late in the walk (likely the Market St east leg)
Second street performer ("This guy's really good, too") - location unnamed
